newsitem.title: USA: Polar Air Cargo names Shimizu director, Japanese Accounts.
newsitem.headline: Polar Air Cargo names Shimizu director, Japanese Accounts.

text.p: Polar Air Cargo, and international all-cargo carrier, has named Junichi Shimizu director of Japanese accounts, responsible for developing and maintaining long-term relationships with Polar's Japanese customers.
Shimuzu joins Polar from Sumitrans Corp., a subsidiary of Sumitomo Corp., Japan, where he consulted on air-cargo shipment strategies.
Before consulting for Sumitrans, he worked with FedEx and Flying Tigers, and prior to that at Northwest Airlines. - Reuters Air Cargo Service Tel+ 44 171 542 7706 Fax +5017 - www.racs.com
